title: Atrial Fibrillation in Young Patients: a Prospective Multicentre Registry
official: Atrial Fibrillation in Young Patients: a Prospective Multicentre Registry
summary: Atrial fibrillation is a rare cardiac arrhythmia in young (i.e. \<= 35-year-old) patients. Etiological factors, current management and mid- to long-term outcomes remain unknown.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* First episode of atrial fibrillation
* Less than 35-year-old
* Diagnostic by 12-lead ECG or continuous monitoring (minimal duration 30 seconds)
* French Social Security number

Exclusion Criteria:

* Transvenous cardiac implantable electronic device (insertable cardiac monitors are not an exclusion criteria)
